hypothesis: On newly seeded causal physical goal tasks, two-step learned-consequence model-predictive control with a bounded epistemic action bonus yields >=10% lower realized goal tracking error than FIT-selected strongest conventional pure two-step MPC, greedy goal-directed, P101 geometric acquisition or random policy, with same factual interventions, capacity and CPU <=2x pure two-step MPC.

source.kind: NEW author-synthetic DEVELOPMENT not external science
source.causal_map: M=V @ U.T/256, two independent maps per world, P86 basis with P103 unique labels
source.goal: public 16D fixed target M @ (2.5 * normalize(hidden goal proposal)); hidden proposal never passed to policies, goal vector visible to all, including strong MPC; goal is in attainable effect subspace
source.physical_state: starts at zero at control phase; each chosen action has actual effect M @ k and physical state increases by that factual effect; goal tracking scored after every executed control step
source.calibration: 8 initial actual interventions per task selected with identical fixed P101 geometric variance policy for all arms; exact same confirmed RLS updates and returned outcome; common state at control start
source.control: 8 more real goal-directed interventions per task with action candidate pools identical across all policies, 8 alternatives per step
source.action_candidates: new deterministic independent signed integers /128, anisotropic dimensions j divided by 2**(j%4) before unit normalize; goal and calibration pool disjoint salts
source.lookahead: current + next candidate pool disclosed to all policies, next true consequence never disclosed; at last step single candidate scoring

learner.same_RLS: exact imported P101 original confirmed action effect update with lambda 0.5; W16x16 float64 and P16x16 float64 per task
learner.persistent_state_per_world: 1024 float64 across two tasks; all arms identical plus same 16D physical state and goal
learner.same_action_budget: 8 calibrate + 8 control = 16 actual confirmed outcomes per task = 32/world per policy

policies.candidate: For each available k_i choose i minimizing min_j ||s+W k_i+ W k_next_j - goal||^2/16 - beta*(k_i^T P k_i)/(mean_candidate_uncertainty+1e-9)*(||goal||^2/16); future k_next_j is hypothetical MODEL prediction only, no factual outcome call. Last step use one-step model error and same bounded bonus.
policies.beta_select: per family/seed FIT ONLY by average 2-task actual physical tracking loss, tie smallest beta; CAL scored exactly once
policies.pure_mpc: Same candidate action pools and exact two-step prediction minimizing goal squared error, beta0, no exploration bonus; unchanged strong comparator
policies.greedy: Conventional one-step goal-distance minimization with same W and physical state
policies.geometry: P101 max k^T P k only, same calibration, goal visible but policy does not use it
policies.random: deterministic candidate index based on new action seed, same per-step options
policies.strong_baseline: FIT-only select minimum tracking MSE from pure_mpc,greedy,geometry,random,cyclic, NEVER CAL-selected; must additionally beat pure_mpc separately
policies.goal_sham: Permute signs of public goal only in chooser while scoring original actual goal, preserve exact simulation/learning budget; posthoc negative must worsen tracking >=5% in each family/seed
policies.wrong_action_credit: Cycle-shift factual action labels and replay actual effect stream; novel-query prediction error must worsen >=5% vs original
policies.zero_predictor: Report tracking cost for doing zero effects, not an eligible comparator

compute.full_episode_timing: same 8 CAL worlds, warmups 2, median 7, full calibration + control + queries; telemetry excluded from timed block
compute.source_and_per_action_receipts: SHA256 source and action journal per arm/seed
